serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: What’s up Shanice?
Shanice: Hi, it’s good to see you!
Shanice: Just so you know. Once again you can repair your bot parts here! My suppliers are operating again.
You: That’s good to hear.
You: Shanice?
Shanice: Yes?
You: As I remember correctly, the last time I was here Priestbot went out, right?
#Nun_NewOutfit.Eyes.StaringIntoDistance+Nun_NewOutfit.Mouth.Smile
Shanice: Oh, you are talking about THAT time.
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceNormal
Shanice: Don’t worry! He’s more or less alright!
You: More or less?! What happened?!
#Nun_NewOutfit.Eyes.StaringIntoDistance+Nun_NewOutfit.Mouth.Smile
Shanice: Well, I can’t really talk about it, cuz I promised I wouldn’t, but if it’s you…
Shanice:Listen to this…{{wi}} Priestbot went out after some thugs, but he got blindsided and they had their way with him! They put a bunch of graffiti on him and scratched him in a few places!
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceHappy
Shanice: Isn’t that the funniest thing ever?!
You: Well…
You: Is he alright?
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceSerious
Shanice: Of course he’s alright. I wouldn’t laugh about it if he wasn’t.
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceHappy
Priestbot: {{punch}}Shanice! I told you not to tell anyone about this!
Shanice: Uh-oh~ I’m in trouble~
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceNormal
Shanice: As you can hear. He’s fine.
Shanice: But damn, he heard us all the way from the back. His hearing is no joke.
You: It was nice talking with you Shanice.
Shanice: What, you are going already?
You: I’m kinda scared what Priestbot may do to me for knowing his secret…
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceHappy
Shanice: Good thinking!
